mechanism_narrative: Retail and recreation mobility has improved monotonically from -39.0 to -28.7 over the four weekly means; this recovery momentum persists as reopening continues, raising RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the last four.
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days despite the four-week improving trend.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM rising above -5.0 marks a shift from panic stockpiling back to normal errands; this normalization frees household time and spending for discretionary trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM is above -5.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS recovery outpaces TRANSIT, indicating outdoor recreation substitutes for transit-dependent trips; nearby retail and recreation footfall benefits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS minus TRANSIT gap exceeds 8 points in a weekly mean
failure_condition: When the PARKS-minus-TRANSIT gap exceeds 8 points, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a work-from-home regime, RESIDENTIAL above 20 combined with WORKPLACES below -30 suppresses commuting-linked retail footfall; RETAIL_REC therefore stays depressed over the next week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean > 20 and WORKPLACES weekly mean < -30
failure_condition: Under the stated residential and workplace conditions, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A TRANSIT weekly mean falling below -40 signals tighter movement restrictions are active or imminent, cutting retail and recreation trips; RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When TRANSIT falls below -40.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A WORKPLACES drop below -34 signals renewed work-from-home directives, reducing weekday commuting and adjacent retail footfall; RETAIL_REC declines over the next week.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES is below -34.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Joint normalization of GROCERY_PHARM above -5.0 and PARKS above -30.0 indicates rising consumer confidence and out-of-home activity; this jointly lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean > -5.0 and PARKS weekly mean > -30.0
failure_condition: When both GROCERY_PHARM > -5.0 and PARKS > -30.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: Mid-year school holiday patterns keep RESIDENTIAL elevated; as the holiday period ends, residential mobility falls and out-of-home retail and recreation activity rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL declines below 22.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the last 28 days.
